summary: Iter31 frontend regression after iter30 hot-fix landed. AuctionDetail.jsx lazy chunk STILL had ONE more missing lucide import (Package) that crashed the whole detail route → naturally triggered LazyErrorBoundary which displayed the retry UI exactly as designed (data-testid='lazy-error-boundary' visible with 'Erneut versuchen' retry button). After hot-fixing the Package import in this iteration, AuctionDetail mounts via Suspense without errors, and ALL food lazy chunks (RestaurantDetailView, CartView, CheckoutView) load end-to-end from a clean restaurant list. atoms.js LIST_POLL_MS=5000 + POLL_MS=2500 is in place. Iter29 button-in-button + empty img src warnings remain ZERO across the full nav flow. HOWEVER duplicate-React-key warnings are NOT fully gone — saw 16 'Encountered two children with the same key' console errors during the /food → restaurant → cart → checkout → /auctions → detail flow. Iter30 reported 0 because that pass only stayed on /auctions list (where they are indeed gone). The dups are emitted from a deeper page (likely RestaurantDetailView menu list, CheckoutView cart-summary, or AuctionDetail bid-history).

ui_bugs.issue: Lucide icon `Package` was used at line 292 (`{ icon: Package, color: accentGold, label: t('auction.shipping_packaging') }`) but NOT in the lucide-react import block. Caused ReferenceError on every auction-card click → entire detail route blank. LazyErrorBoundary correctly caught it and rendered retry UI. HOT-FIXED in this iteration by adding `Package` to the import list (line 7).

16 'Encountered two children with the same key, %s' React errors during cross-page navigation flow. Iter30 had reported 0 but only on the /auctions list. The dups appear after entering deeper pages (RestaurantDetailView menu items / CheckoutView line items / AuctionDetail bid-history are the most likely candidates). React's `%s` placeholder hides the actual key value in Playwright capture — main agent should reproduce locally with React DevTools to identify the exact .map(...) producing duplicates.

integration_issues.issue: Admin still has a 'Group Order BEREIT' banner pinned at the top of /food (with Details + close X). It NO LONGER blocks RestaurantListView (12 cards render correctly), so this is non-blocking, but the iter30 ticket said /api/food/delivered cleared the order — visually the banner is still there. May be a different group-order entity or the cleanup endpoint didn't dismiss the BEREIT-state banner.

rca_of_the_issue: The Package icon (lucide-react) is referenced on line 292 of /app/frontend/src/components/auctions/AuctionDetail.jsx but was missing from the import block on lines 4-8. Iter30 had patched four other missing icons (Gavel, Clock, TrendingUp, Wallet) but missed Package. Symptom: every click on an auction card emitted `ReferenceError: Package is not defined` → React unwound to the LazyErrorBoundary which rendered the retry UI (so the user wasn't stranded — boundary works). Mitigation applied in this iter: appended `Package` to the lucide-react named-import list. Long-term: enable eslint no-undef in CI for all extracted lazy components.
